description: This file defines utility functions and a public interface to suggest standard parameter keys for a vendor based on a query string. It includes functions for tokenizing strings, calculating Jaccard similarity, and querying a database collection to generate suggestions with confidence scores.

methods.name: List[str] _tokenize(s: str)
methods.description: Tokenizes a string into a list of alphanumeric lowercase tokens.

methods.name: float _jaccard(a: List[str], b: List[str])
methods.description: Computes the Jaccard similarity between two lists of tokens.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] suggest_standard_keys(vendor_id: str, query: str, limit: int = 5)
methods.description: Suggests standard parameter keys for a vendor based on a query, using regex matching and token overlap scoring.

ctags.name: suggest_standard_keys
ctags.pattern: /^def suggest_standard_keys(vendor_id: str, query: str, limit: int = 5) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
